national_news.title: India Records $11.3 Billion FPI Inflows in November: Chief Economic Adviser
bullets: Speaking at the 65th General Assembly and Annual Meeting of the World Federation of Exchanges (WFE) in Mumbai, Chief Economic Adviser Dr. V. Anantha Nageswaran highlighted $11.3 billion in FPI inflows during the first 18 days of November.
India sustained nearly 7% real GDP growth and recorded $569 billion in goods and services exports from April to October, marking a nearly 17% year-on-year growth rate.

The CEA outlined five key challenges for 'Viksit Bharat by 2047': geopolitical fragmentation, China's manufacturing dominance, the energy trilemma, AI-led job shifts, and social media's impact on youth cognitive skills.

national_news.title: India and Japan Expand Maritime Security and Joint Defence Manufacturing Cooperation
bullets: India and Japan held their 4th 2+2 Foreign and Defence Ministerial Dialogue in Tokyo, reviewing bilateral ties under the Special Strategic and Global Partnership ahead of 75 years of diplomatic relations in 2027.

Both nations agreed to fast-track defence agreements for the Unified Complex Radio Antenna (UNICORN) stealth naval mast project and expand collaboration under the 'Design with Japan, Make in India' framework.
The talks emphasized maintaining a free and open Indo-Pacific with Quad partners, enhancing maritime and air domain awareness, and promoting reciprocal access to ship repair facilities.

national_news.title: Government Revises PUC Certificate Validity and Renewal Intervals for Vehicles
bullets: The Ministry of Road Transport and Highways amended the Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989, to revise Pollution Under Control (PUC) certificate validity periods based on emission standards and vehicle age.
BS-I, II, and III vehicles retain a 3-month validity, while BS-IV vehicles have a 6-month validity.
For BS-VI non-transport vehicles, validity is set at 3 years for vehicles up to 6 years old, 1 year for 6-10 years, and 6 months for those older than 10 years.

national_news.title: PM Modi Addresses FICCI Centenary Convention, Urges 'India First' Approach
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the centenary convention of FICCI in New Delhi, urging industries to base long-term investments on an 'India First' strategy over the next 20 years.
Highlighted India's macroeconomic resilience, noting a projected GDP growth rate of around 7% and record monthly goods exports nearing 50 billion dollars.
Cited World Bank findings that 50 crore individuals were lifted out of poverty over the last 12 to 13 years due to targeted policy interventions and structural tax reforms.

national_news.title: RBI Deputy Governor Emphasizes Technology Risks and Strategy in Banking Sector
bullets: RBI Deputy Governor S.C. Murmu highlighted the need for banks to invest in technology and human resources to mitigate technology risks and prevent misconduct.
The banking sector is transitioning to the Expected Credit Loss (ECL) framework and implementing the remaining Basel-III standards.
Bank boards were urged to ensure that AI-driven credit, collections, and fraud detection systems remain explainable, fair, and accountable.

national_news.title: Union Minister Prataprao Jadhav Reviews Expansion Plans of National Institute of Unani Medicine
bullets: Union Minister of State for Ayush Prataprao Jadhav chaired the 13th Governing Body meeting of the National Institute of Unani Medicine (NIUM) in New Delhi.
Expansion plans include adding five new postgraduate departments, 35 seats, and a Department of Integrative and Translational Research at the main campus.
A second campus featuring a 200-bed referral hospital and research infrastructure is planned in Ghaziabad, alongside reserving 24 seats for foreign students.

national_news.title: India and Burkina Faso Explore Bilateral Cooperation in Traditional Medicine and Medicinal Plant Conservation
bullets: Union Minister for Ayush Prataprao Jadhav held bilateral talks with a visiting delegation from Burkina Faso led by Roger Baro in New Delhi.
Discussions focused on traditional medicine standardisation, medicinal plant conservation, Yoga wellness programmes, and institutional partnerships.
Both nations explored a joint project involving India's National Medicinal Plants Board and framework agreements via the Ministry of Ayush.

national_news.title: India Signs Rs 1,976 Crore Deal with Israel Aerospace Industries for Barak Missile System Upgrade
bullets: The Ministry of Defence signed a contract worth Rs 1,976.40 crore with Israel Aerospace Industries (IAI) on November 18, 2026, in New Delhi.
The project involves upgrading the hardware and software of the Barak Point Defence Missile System on Indian Navy ships and replacing outdated components.
The agreement was signed under the Other Capital Procurement Procedure in the presence of Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh.

national_news.title: IFFI 2026 Introduces 'Films About Films' Section for International Cinema
bullets: The 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI) introduced a new section titled 'Films About Films', featuring five international movies under the theme 'Stories Without Borders'.
The debut section highlights the craft, challenges, and lives of filmmakers and the history of cinema, featuring productions from 10 countries.
The lineup includes documentaries such as Barnaby Thompson's 'Maverick: The Epic Adventures of David Lean' focusing on legendary director David Lean.

national_news.title: Archaeological Survey of India Offers Free Entry to Monuments for World Heritage Week
bullets: The Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) offered free entry to all its protected monuments on November 19, 2026, to mark the opening day of World Heritage Week.
World Heritage Week is observed annually from November 19 to 25 across the country.
The ASI protects over 3,800 monuments nationwide, of which 143 are ticketed, including major landmarks like the Taj Mahal, Red Fort, and Qutub Minar.

bihar_news.title: Adani Energy Solutions Secures Rs 500-Crore Annual Tariff Transmission Project in Bihar
bullets: Adani Energy Solutions Ltd (AESL) secured a transmission project in Bihar with an annual tariff of Rs 500 crore via the tariff-based competitive bidding (TBCB) route.
The project is aimed at evacuating 2,400 MW of electricity from Adani Power's upcoming ultra-supercritical thermal power plant at Pirpainti.
Scheduled for completion by Q4 2028, the project will be executed through a special purpose vehicle named Vikramshila Power Transmission Ltd.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Requests Dry Port Facility Expansion Beyond Bihta to Boost Trade
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary announced on November 19, 2026, that the state has requested Union Minister Piyush Goyal and the Ministry of Railways to extend dry port facilities beyond Bihta.
The expansion aims to support 12 upcoming townships projected to attract investments worth ₹12 lakh crore.
Bihar Foundation currently has international chapters in 31 countries, which the state intends to leverage to access global markets and boost youth employment through industrial growth.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government to Develop State's First IT Park in Patna
bullets: The Bihar government is developing its first IT park in Patna with an estimated investment of ₹413 crore near Bapu Tower in Gardanibagh.
National Buildings Construction Corporation (NBCC) will execute the project, which will span 7.43 lakh square feet and house over 100 companies.

The integrated facility will feature dedicated IT and commercial blocks, a seven-storey five-star hotel, and an eight-storey residential block as part of a broader ₹2,000 crore redevelopment initiative.

bihar_news.title: Kachchi Dargah-Bidupur Bridge Named 'Nitish Setu'
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary announced on 13 November 2026 that the newly constructed six-lane Kachchi Dargah-Bidupur Bridge over the Ganga River will be named 'Nitish Setu'.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to inaugurate the bridge on 21 November 2026.

The bridge connects Kachchi Dargah in Patna district with Bidupur in Vaishali district through Raghopur, featuring a main bridge length of approximately 9.76 km and a total length of 19.76 km including approach roads.
